question: Himangi starts from Point A and drives 2 km towards the east. She then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns left and drives 9 km. She then takes a left turn and drives 3 km. She takes a final left turn, drives 11 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given: **Himangi starts from Point A and drives 2 km towards the east. She then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns left and drives 9 km. She then takes a left turn and drives 3 km. She takes a final left turn, drives 11 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96b4cc1a278ec07237c1419e057d68a018fb4149ff54a28b2e3470ea2f1809b6.png] 

Thus, she should drive 4 km towards the north in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
